# Terracode

> Terracode is a software development company in Colombo, Sri Lanka, building custom software, AI solutions, websites, mobile applications, cloud systems, and user experiences for startups and enterprises.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.terracodedev.com/): Company overview, services, process, and contact options.
- [About Terracode](https://www.terracodedev.com/about): Information about the company and team.
- [Portfolio](https://www.terracodedev.com/digitalportfolio): Selected software and digital product projects.
- [Articles](https://www.terracodedev.com/articles): Terracode articles and product insights.
- [Contact](https://www.terracodedev.com/contact): Contact details and project enquiries.
- [Careers](https://www.terracodedev.com/career): Career opportunities at Terracode.

## Services

- [AI Solutions](https://www.terracodedev.com/ai-solutions): Custom AI models, automation, analytics, and integrations.
- [Business Software](https://www.terracodedev.com/business-softwares): Custom ERP, CRM, inventory, and operational systems.
- [Website Solutions](https://www.terracodedev.com/website-solutions): Responsive, performant, and SEO-ready websites.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.terracodedev.com/mobile-apps): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android applications.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://www.terracodedev.com/cloud-solutions): Cloud migration, infrastructure, DevOps, and monitoring.
- [UX Design](https://www.terracodedev.com/ux-design): User research, prototyping, accessibility, and usability testing.
